title: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files
description: Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint, and Microsoft Excel files now open in a standardized preview in Teams on Android and iOS, delivering faster performance, improved reliability, and a more consistent viewing experience.
